//: Type checking for a plain-JSX project. `checkJs` + `allowJs` means tsc validates the existing .js/.jsx sources WITHOUT renaming any of them. Gate: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit).
//tuning: This gate is deliberately NOT fully strict. Full `strict` produced 205 errors on this untyped codebase and 190 of them were the SAME root cause — `useState()`/`useRef()` with no type argument infers `null`/`never`, so every later read/write on that value is flagged. Those are typing gaps, not bugs. What this config DOES keep is the set that found real defects: untyped `catch` values read as if they were Error, a genuinely missing prop, and `EventTarget` vs `currentTarget`.
//see-also: docs/PROJECT-RULES.md -> Verification. Diagnostics for the two OFF options are recorded in the log for 2026-10-05.
//includes-dts: `src/**/*.d.ts` must be listed explicitly — a glob of `src/**/*.js` does NOT pull in the ambient declaration files, and their types would then be silently missing.
